description:
Doors mod with lock tool to open, lock or protect any registered door.

Doors Redo replaces the default doors mod and adds the following features:

- Lock Tool that can flip all doors between open, locked and protected.
- Keys can still be used to allow fellow players to open your locked doors and chests.
- Registered doors only require 2x nodes instead of the default 4.
- Adds two new decorative doors and one decorative trapdoor.

Note: A protection mod is required when using protected door option.
